target_customer: Audit firms and financial advisors that work in Microsoft Excel
problem: Auditors repeat manual testing, ledger analysis and statement tie-outs. Moby provides AI agents inside Excel that automate these tasks with every figure linked to its source for review and sign off.
business_model: B2B SaaS per user licence, Essential plan about 348 EUR per user per year, custom enterprise plan from 50 licences

founders.name: Dimitri Kassubeck
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked a decade in the financial industry serving the largest companies in the world; employers not named.

founders.name: Thomas Rapilly
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Clement Sengelen
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the YC launch post; title from a search summary.

competitors.name: DataSnipper
competitors.what: Excel based audit automation platform; announced AI agents with Microsoft in 2025-07 and launched them 2025-10-01
competitors.funding_then: $100M Series B in 2024 per a third party article

competitors.name: MindBridge
competitors.what: AI transaction analysis for audit and finance
competitors.funding_then: over $50M raised per a third party article

competitors.name: Fieldguide
competitors.funding_then: $92M total per a third party article

technical_complexity.rationale: Excel add-in with source linked figures and agent workflows needs accuracy and traceability for audit use, moderate but built on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integration and auditor trust help, but DataSnipper already dominates Excel audit work and ships agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DataSnipper launched Excel agents with Microsoft on 2025-10-01 and Thomson Reuters announced audit partnerships in 2025-12; no acquisition of Moby found.

market_need_then: Founders ran a data analytics agency that trained hundreds of auditors before building the product (YC launch post), showing direct exposure to demand; independent spend data not collected.

branding.domain_note: Uses mobyanalytics.com, an exact name plus descriptor .com.

identity.logo: Simple monochrome mark, icon in dark gray 1b1b1a
identity.visual_style: Minimal dark gray and white palette with Excel mockups and an ocean horizon hero video
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct, benefit focused, professional, stresses user control

brand_strength.rationale: Moby is also the name of an unrelated Triple Whale AI product and a Moby Audit listing exists, so the name is confusable; no brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Moby Analytics is an active YC Spring 2025 company selling an Excel add-in to auditors, listed on Microsoft AppSource with published pricing. It shares its category with DataSnipper, which shipped agents with Microsoft later in 2025. Funding is only reported by aggregators and no exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is still open.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights lists $500K over 2 rounds with a seed dated 2025-06-06 and Transpose Platform as investor; StartupHub lists $2M. Both aggregators, so no round recorded. Founding year conflicts across aggregators (2022, 2023, 2025), so left null. HQ conflicts between Paris, Vienna and New York. Education of founders not found. Competitor funding figures come from a third party article on Audrey AI. Completeness pass: one seed round of about 500K dated 2025-06-06 is recorded from CB Insights alone; it rests on a single database. StartupHub says 2M total, an unresolved gap.
